verdict.rationale: Munito AI documents API keys sent via Authorization or X-API-Key headers and managed in a console. Nothing in the pack shows keys can be scoped, restricted to specific models or endpoints, or given least-privilege permissions for an agent. Plain key issuance is an adjacent capability, not scoped credentials, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
